name: Return the Statuette
label: Quest
description: Return the Statuette: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: After pulling the barrel free from the muck and opening it, a silvery figurine is found packed in fine straw. It depicts a young, long-haired Paladin with hammer upraised.
This must be the Menethil Statuette! You must now return it to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The captain of the Blind Princess will be relieved to hear this precious cargo has been recovered. You have well earned this payment for services rendered.
It is good to see dependable folk like you, especially in trying times such as these.
